digest.component_or_area: ticket store Success-Criteria to Acceptance-Criteria migration script
propositions: Tickets carrying `## Success Criteria` as plain `- ` bullets are invisible to `_count_ac_items`, the P1 blocking floor, and the completion verifier's checkbox matching.

A migration script under scripts/ rewrites matching tickets via rebar.edit_ticket, converting SC bullets to `- [ ]` items merged under `## Acceptance Criteria`, defaulting to --dry-run with an explicit flag required to touch non-closed tickets.
Editing descriptions changes the material fingerprint and invalidates plan-review attestations as stale-material, an expected and unavoidable cost.
The dry-run caught an order-sensitivity defect that duplicated headings and criteria and broke idempotency for 97 of 104 tickets, fixed with an order-agnostic _splice helper.
The live run migrated 106 tickets across two passes, the second handling qualified headings like `## Success Criteria (target state)` missed by exact-string matching.
Post-migration verification confirms zero remaining SC headings, every migrated ticket returns _count_ac_items>=1, and pre-run descriptions were captured for rollback.
